synthesis:draft.headline: POE50 10954.0 MW vs actual 11178.0 MW at 2026-07-31 07:30 AEST (UTC+1000): forecast −224.0 MW.
summary: POE50 forecast for interval ending 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z (2026-07-31 07:30 AEST (UTC+1000)): 10954.0 MW (evidence: ev0676).
Actual operational demand for the same interval: 11178.0 MW (evidence: ev0677).
Error (POE50 − actual): −224.0 MW (evidence: ev0678), which is −2.0% of actual (evidence: ev0679).
Forecast mean absolute error (MAE) for this run over the 24 half-hours: 317.17 MW (evidence: ev0754).

possible_explanations.statement: The run's POE50 may have underestimated short-term upward changes in demand around the evening peak; compare successive public forecast runs around issued_at_utc 2026-07-30T18:27:01Z and their POE50 values against actuals (ev0676, ev0677).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare POE50 across public forecast runs issued near 2026-07-30T18:27:01Z and actuals for 2026-07-31 07:30 AEST (UTC+1000) (ev0676, ev0677).

possible_explanations.statement: The forecast error might reflect short-term weather deviations around 2026-07-31 07:30 AEST (UTC+1000).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Retrieve weather observations and forecasts for 2026-07-31 07:30 AEST (UTC+1000) (run get_weather_context for that interval) and compare to the weather inputs used by the forecast.

possible_explanations.statement: The difference could be associated with unmodelled or late-arriving wholesale demand response or other operational adjustments; check operational-demand revisions and any AEMO market notices for NSW1 in the event window.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Inspect operational demand revision history and AEMO market notices for NSW1 covering 2026-07-30T09:30:00Z to 2026-07-31T09:30:00Z, and compare timing with the interval 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z (2026-07-31 07:30 AEST (UTC+1000)).
